name: Lovage

schedule.notes: Or transplant a division — faster start. Pick a permanent spot; plants reach 5 to 7 ft tall.
Year 1: leaves only. Year 2+: leaves freely; cut flower stalks to keep flavor in the leaves.

harvest.cues: Hollow stems and bright green leaves smell intensely of celery and yeast. Stems 12+ in.
harvest.storageNotes: Fresh leaves wilt fast — chop and freeze in cubes for soups. Roots can be dried and ground as seasoning.

varieties.name: Common Lovage
varieties.notes: The one and only. Tall, celery-flavored, perennial.

notes: Strong celery-meets-curry flavor — use sparingly. Place at the back of an herb bed; gets head-tall by summer. Hollow stems make natural straws (use small ones in Bloody Marys).
